headline: Suzuki Fills The Gap For test4
deck: Suzuki keeps goal in Villa's first win; Martinez, owned by test3331, watches on.
body:
The Villa goal has changed hands, and so has the draft value in it. Zion Suzuki, on test4's rolls, kept a clean sheet as Villa took their first league win of the season at Tottenham. For a manager already leaning on his newest men to close a hole, a goalkeeper delivering in the fixture is the answer test4 needed.

For test3331 it is the other side of the same coin. Emiliano Martinez, still owned here, no longer holds the position, and the wire does not say when or whether that changes. What is known is that the return came from the man in the sticks, and the man in the sticks belongs to somebody else.
